purpose: Perform the pending longer held-out neural validation, including the corrected learned-energy DCT candidate, without editing the original Hamiltonian.

reference.scope: Fixed N=128; same declared smooth manufactured initial family as the pilot. Held-out seeds 12-15 were not used in preceding experiments. All kappa variants of an initial state stay in the same split. Reference validity and fixed-grid step refinement are distinct from spatial convergence or experimental physical validation.

training.supervision: All three receive identical training/validation states and exact split-operator/heat labels. The two energy models learn H from reference gradients, reversible rates and energy differences; no native Hamiltonian calls at neural inference. Direct baseline predicts conservative RHS and unit-kappa dissipative rates/heat with the known kappa factorization. This is supervised learning of labeled operators, not blind identification from trajectories alone.
training.selection: Select each checkpoint using validation loss only and save/hash it before test arrays are opened by training/evaluation. No test-dependent training or checkpoint selection. Equal update and backbone width/depth budgets; report parameter counts, not a false claim of identical counts.
training.normalization: Computed from training rows only; record all arrays. Fixed canonical J and native state ordering; positive log-content chart for integration. Friction acts only on equal-and-opposite phase directions. Auxiliary heat is formal extensive storage, not a calibrated physical entropy.

rollout.method: Batched float64 fixed-step RK4 in the native positive-content log chart
rollout.primary: All 20 held-out initial-state/kappa cases for each new model, unless a declared stability budget is exceeded. Failures and last reached times are reported rather than clipped or repaired.
metrics: Total heat error and negative-heat fraction
Rollout state error versus native reference and persistence
Native H plus predicted heat drift
Learned H plus predicted heat drift

additional_check: Evaluate the previously frozen short-trained hybrid networks on the new longer test data without retraining or selecting weights using these tests. Full hybrid long rollouts use validation-selected primary weights and predeclared cases seed12/13 kappa100/500 for computational comparison, with the native conservative integrator retained.
training_implementation: Two same-width/depth DCT backbones per model. The direct model has a conservative/auxiliary-energy head and an independent phase/heat head. The two GENERIC models have a scalar energy head and a positive scalar mobility head with a fixed rank-one equal-and-opposite phase direction, a special case of the audited rank-K factorization. A training-only mean radial mobility profile and observed active support are shared with the direct head; exact native mobility/torque is not provided at inference. Learned H is offset by mean training H; energy labels carry weight 0.01 in addition to equally weighted normalized conservative and dissipative/heat losses. One training seed is an exploratory architecture comparison, not a statistical superiority test.
not_claimed: experimental validation of gravity or other physical applications
statistical superiority from one neural training seed
reproduction of the authors' stock paper experiments
publication of new results on GitHub
